title: Put your goods in
headline: Put your *goods* in
sub: Photos, prices and sizes: a party pack in every size.

recap.en: Ada's Kitchen is open on Taskiem. Time to put the menu in.
recap.pcm: Ada's Kitchen don open for Taskiem. Make we put the menu inside.

bridge.en: It is lunchtime and the orders are coming in. How does Ada take them?
bridge.pcm: Na lunchtime and orders dey come. How Ada go take dem?

flow.action: Arranges a party pack of jollof rice and chicken on a steel counter and photographs it with her phone, then checks the picture and smiles
flow.setting: Ada's Kitchen in Yaba: white tiles, steel counters, big steaming pots, a bright window onto a yellow-painted wall, a counter with a receipt printer

flow.action: Looks at his phone at the counter as a message arrives, reads it and looks up at Ada with raised brows
flow.setting: Ada's Kitchen in Yaba: white tiles, steel counters, big steaming pots, a bright window onto a yellow-painted wall, a counter with a receipt printer

en: Ada puts her party pack on the menu.
She opens Products, then Add product.
She types the name, the category, and the price.
Add product. The party pack is in.
To sell it in sizes, she opens it.
Sizes: five plates, ten plates, twenty plates.
She fills in the counts, then changes one.
pcm: Ada dey put her party pack for the menu.
She open Products, then Add product.
She type the name, the category, and the price.
Add product. The party pack don enter.
To sell am for sizes, she open am.
Sizes: five plates, ten plates, twenty plates.
She fill the counts, then change one.
Save. Three sizes, ready to sell.
